content.text:
The `POST /api/owners` request is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:123`). Here is everything applied, in execution order. I've tagged each as **[V]** validation (can reject the request) or **[S]** side-effect (mutates the payload or the owner).

## Before the method body

1. **[V] Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` (line 121). Caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role.
2. **[V] Bean Validation** on the `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (`OwnersApi.java:86`), evaluated against the DTO constraints before `addOwner` runs. Violations → 400:
   - `firstName` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern ^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$`
   - `lastName` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern ^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$`
   - `address` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..255)`
   - `city` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`
   - `telephone` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`
   - `email` — `@Size(max 255)` (optional)
   - `postcode` — `@Pattern ^[0-9]{4}$` (optional)

   (Note: the `Owner` *entity* also carries `@NotEmpty`/`@Pattern` constraints, but the inbound DTO is what's validated here.)

## Inside `addOwner`, in order (lines 124–141)

3. **[S] `normalizeAddress`** (124) — trims, collapses internal whitespace, upper-cases, and expands street abbreviations (`ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`). Written back onto the DTO. `null` left as-is.
4. **[V] `validateRequiredFields`** (125) — rejects if `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is null/blank → `RequiredFieldsMissingException`. (Catches whitespace-only `address`/`city`, which have no pattern.)
5. **[V] `validatePostcode`** (126) — if `postcode` present and the city's region is known (Sydney→NSW 2000–2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000–3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000–4099), must fall in range → else `InvalidPostcodeException`. Unknown region accepts any 4-digit value; null postcode skipped.
6. **[S] + [V] `normalizeTelephone`** (127) — converts to E.164 via `toE164` (strips spaces/dashes/brackets; keeps `+`/country code or assumes `+61` dropping a leading `0`; requires 8–15 digits, with `+61`→exactly 9 national digits and `+1`→exactly 10). Writes canonical value back; if it can't form valid E.164 → `RequiredFieldsMissingException("telephone")`.
7. **[S] + [V] `normalizeEmail`** (128) — if present: trims, must match the email regex (else `InvalidEmailException`), then written back lower-cased. Null skipped.
8. **[V] `rejectDuplicateIdentity`** (129) — computes an identity key `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId` (household id = SHA-256 of collapsed `lastName`+`address`) and rejects if any existing owner has the same *whole* key → `DuplicateIdentityException` (409).
9. **[V] `rejectCityAtCapacity`** (130) — rejects if the city already holds ≥ `CITY_CAPACITY` (50) owners, case-insensitive → `CityAtCapacityException` (409).
10. **[S] `defaultRegistrationDate`** (131) — if no `registrationDate` supplied, defaults to `LocalDate.now()`; then rolls Sat→Mon / Sun→Mon (business day). Written back onto the DTO.
11. **[V] `rejectDailyLimit`** (132) — rejects if ≥ `DAILY_LIMIT` (100) existing owners already carry that (adjusted) registration date → `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException` (429).

## Owner object assembly (lines 134–140)

12. **[S] `ownerMapper.toOwner`** (134) — maps the normalized DTO into an `Owner` entity.
13. **[S] `assignCustomerCode`** (135) — sets `customerCode` = `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, where NNNN is one more than the current per-city owner count.
14. **[S] `assignHouseholdId`** (136) — sets `householdId` = `HH-<first 12 hex of SHA-256(collapsed lastName + "\n" + collapsed address)>`.
15. **[S] `assignHouseholdMemberCount`** (137) — sets `householdMemberCount` = existing owners sharing that `householdId`, plus one.
16. **[S] `assignNamesakeCount`** (138) — sets `namesakeCount` = existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive), taken before persist.
17. **[S] `assignMembershipNumber`** (139) — sets `membershipNumber` = `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (last two digits of the registration-date year).
18. **[S] `assignBulkSignupWarning`** (140) — sets `bulkSignupWarning` = true when > `BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD` (80) existing owners already carry that registration date.

## Persist and respond (lines 141–147)

19. **[S] `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`** (141) — persists the owner (assigns its id).
20. **[S] Audit log** (142) — `AUDIT` logger emits `id / customerCode / registrationDate / membershipLevel`.
21. **[S] Response** (144–147) — maps to `OwnerDto`, sets `Location: /api/owners/{id}`, returns **201 Created**.

## Two things worth flagging in the current code

- **`sharesHousehold` is documented but never read.** The DTO says setting it to `true` lets a same-household create bypass the 409. But `rejectDuplicateIdentity` (the only duplicate check that runs) never consults `getSharesHousehold()`, and it keys on telephone/email too — so two household members with different phones already pass without the flag, and the flag has no effect anywhere in the flow.
- **Membership level is not assigned here.** `getMembershipLevel()` is a `@Transient` derived getter on `Owner` (computed on read from `email` and `namesakeCount`); the audit line at step 20 reads it, but nothing persists it.

I haven't changed anything — this is a read-only description of the code as it stands.
